# Format of `config/site.yaml`

<!-- GENERATED by taxidermist from taxonomy/. Do not hand-edit: edit the schema and run `taxidermist docs`. -->

## Copy this

```yaml
name: <str>
timezone: <str>
default_team: <hiring-panel | platform>   # optional
labels:   # optional
  <name>: <str>
```

## What to put in each field

**`name`** · required · `str`  
The name the knowledge base goes by.

**`timezone`** · required · `str` · matches `^[A-Z][A-Za-z_]+/[A-Za-z_]+$`  
An IANA zone. Dates in the pages are local to it.

**`default_team`** · optional · `str`  
The team a page with no owner falls to.

Values: `hiring-panel` · `platform`, defined below.

**`labels`** · optional · `map`  
Labels a page may carry, each with what it marks.

Each key matches `^[a-z]+$`.

- each value · `str`: What the label marks.

## What the values mean

### `default_team`

Shared vocabulary [`team`](vocabularies/team.md), read from [`config/teams.yaml`](../../config/teams.yaml).

| value | means |
|---|---|
| `hiring-panel` | Runs interviews and decides on offers. |
| `platform` | Keeps the servers and the build running. |

## Adding a value

A field's `definitions` keys **are** its allowed values, so a value cannot exist until someone writes down what it means. Prefer an existing one, because a near-synonym fragments every filter. If nothing fits, add it to the right file under [taxonomy/](../README.md) with its one line, in the same change that uses it. `taxidermist check` fails otherwise.
